def toml_of(entries):
    out = []
    for e in entries:
        out.append('[[suite]]')
        for k, v in e.items():
            if isinstance(v, str):
                out.append(f'{k} = "{v}"')
            elif isinstance(v, list):
                items = ', '.join(f'"{x}"' if isinstance(x, str) else str(x) for x in v)
                out.append(f'{k} = [{items}]')
            else:
                out.append(f'{k} = {v}')
        out.append('')
    return '\n'.join(out)
